name: Hipparikko ~Shimai ga H Battle?!~
original_name: ひっぱりっこ～姉妹がHバトル？！～
source: Ten years after the divorce of his parents, the main character returns to his mother's house. There live his two sisters and his mom whom he got separated with because of family circumstances. They have to cohabit once again and...
translation: 父母离婚十年后，主角回到母亲家。那里住着他的两个姐妹和他因家庭原因而分居的母亲。他们必须再次同居，然后……
